images.filename: 美空軍337戰鬥攔擊機中隊接替83戰鬥攔擊機中隊台海防務.jpg
images.caption: The commander of the U.S. Air Force’s 337th Fighter Interceptor Squadron (J.JABARA) and his flying ground crew arrived in Taiwan from the United States on December 6 to replace the 83rd Fighter Interceptor. The defense of the squadron. The picture shows Lieutenant Colonel Gabriel (right) receiving a welcome from Lieutenant Colonel J.B. BAUNETT (left), commander of the Eighty-third Squadron when he arrives in Taiwan. The U.S. military once announced that this was just a change of defense. The aircraft and equipment will be retained by the 337th Squadron. Both squadrons use the latest F-104A star fighters.

images.filename: 駐紮於桃園空軍基地的美國空軍第83戰鬥攔截機中隊.jpg
images.caption: After the 83rd Combat Interceptor Squadron equipped with the fastest F-104A jet fighter of the U.S. Air Force was stationed in Taiwan for assistance in defense, the U.S. Army’s Defense Taiwan Command hosted a visit to a base in the northern part of our air force on September 17th. The picture shows US soldiers disinfecting lunch boxes and tableware.
